answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the haven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the cipher of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
